mecha-layla.name: Mecha Layla
mecha-layla.capabilities: Capable of setting up a mecha that can never be targeted in the ally back row to deal continuous damage to enemies. Suitable for prolonged battles.

melodic-lunabelle.name: Melodic Lunabelle
melodic-lunabelle.description: Lunabelle was once just a child from a Common craftsman's family in Eruditio. Though inspired by QUNN to develop an interest in music and performance, she kept this aspiration buried in her heart after all, such a dream seemed far too distant. Then she met Eris, a young agent who was the only one able to appreciate the charm of her singing. Eris accidentally discovered that Lunabelle's voice possessed a mysterious magical power that could even breathe life into machines, and she sincerely suggested that Lunabelle share her voice with more people. Will Lunabelle's long-buried dream shine once again?

mystic-mystia.description: "Mystia, the deity in charge of games, arrives at the Land of Dawn with a unique anticipation for the Commander. Hopefully, "you" can help alter the destined ending." (Skin Overview)

naiad-rafaela.description: "The angel awakens, once feeble wings now aglow with rejuvenation. The power of rejuvenation courses through Rafaela, as she bestows upon the world greater love, solace and warmth." (Skin Overview)

natalia.description: Natalia walks the darkness of the night all year round, completing any missions assigned by the Monastery of Light and clearing all obstacles standing in the way of the Moniyan Empire.

natan.name: Natan
natan.description: Natan stood as Eruditio's leader, guiding the people in their search for hope in this world. Yet having faced numerous defeats he decided instead to cast his gaze not to the future, but to the past—by inventing a time machine. What future would the time-travelling savior bring to the world?

natsu.description: Natsu, known as the Salamander, is a mage skilled in Fire Dragon Slayer Magic. He is capable of unleashing scathing attacks upon enemies.

night-blade.name: Night Blade
night-blade.description: Night Blade is a hero that presumably works as one of Alice's servants, since she appears on the campain levels as an enemy that tries to stop us to catch up to her, her race is unknown. In appearence she has short blue hair and blue pale skin, her eyes are magenta and wears a dark purple lipstick, on her ears diamond shaped earrings and on body a black suit composed by a black top that seems to be composed by black bandages and a long side skirt which is holded by a waistband with silver finishes; on her hands wears black wristbands and her feets are bare, but has some black bandages wrapped around; she uses two hook blades as weapons.

night-drummer.name: Night Drummer
night-drummer.description: He has light purple skin, except for his right hand and left foot that are light pink. His eyes are magenta and he covers his face with a piece of black fabric, he has rings made of metal on both his wrists and ankles. He wears a thorn piece of purple fabric and carries a drum in front of him. He plays the drum using two bones.
